c: pull mirrors every metadata record into git.
say: First, pull mirrors every metadata record of the instance into a git repository. Later pulls bring only what changed: with nothing new, about 22 small requests.

c: describe and find read the mirror, not the instance.
say: Then describe and find read the mirror, not the instance. They explain what runs on a table, in execution order, with no load on the instance.

c: adopt brings records into Fluent, where you edit.
say: To change something, adopt it into Fluent source, the ServiceNow S D K's TypeScript. You or your agent edit it there, and new records are written in Fluent too.
sub: To change something, adopt it into Fluent source, the ServiceNow SDK's TypeScript. You or your agent edit it there, and new records are written in Fluent too.

c: validate reports only what your change introduced.
say: Validate builds the source and checks it against 41 rules for security, performance, upgradability, manageability and user experience.

c: plan-push shows each unit, collisions and drift.
say: Plan-push shows exactly what would be loaded, what someone else holds in an open update set, and what changed on the instance since you started.

c: push loads the reviewed plan, and only that plan.
say: Push loads that reviewed plan, and only that plan, into an update set on a development instance, then reads each load back to check it was recorded.

c: Each branch gets its own update set batch.
say: Each branch, and so each pull request, gets its own update set batch. Pull again, and the mirror shows what you built.
